project: Academy Beyond This World: The Hidden System
golden_rule: The Academy does not reveal itself. It responds to perception.

ROOM_CORRIDOR_EAST.name: East Corridor

ROOM_CORRIDOR_EAST.floor: Dark polished stone — reflections slightly wrong even in normal state
ROOM_CORRIDOR_EAST.scale_rule: Must feel larger than the characters

ROOM_OBSERVATORY_MAIN.name: Main Observatory
ROOM_OBSERVATORY_MAIN.architecture: Circular floor, brass telescope, star map ceiling

ROOM_LIBRARY_MAIN.name: Library Archive
ROOM_LIBRARY_MAIN.emotional_function: Hidden truth — knowledge that is incomplete

ROOM_HIDDEN_HALL.name: Hidden Halls
ROOM_HIDDEN_HALL.emotional_function: Deep mystery — the system beneath the system

morning.visual_mood: Soft gold, mist in gardens, long shadows

night.visual_mood: Deep navy, silver moonlight, stars visible indoors

autumn.atmosphere: Warm amber, falling leaves, memory traces more visible

spring.atmosphere: Soft green-gold, renewal, garden spiral grows

summer.atmosphere: Bright warm gold, social energy, long days

ASTRA.core_trait: Emotionally grounded, quietly observant, thoughtful before acting
ASTRA.arc: Something is wrong → Reality responds to perception
ASTRA.hair: Dark indigo-purple, slightly wavy, medium length

LUMI.core_trait: Analytical, calm, notebook-centred, finds comfort in structure
LUMI.arc: Everything can be understood → Understanding requires emotional openness
LUMI.hair: Light blonde, neat, often tucked behind ears
LUMI.signature: Always holding or near her notebook

NELA.core_trait: Energetic, improvisational, movement-oriented, feels before she thinks
NELA.arc: Follow the feeling → Connection itself changes reality
NELA.signature: Mismatched earrings — one star, one moon

notebook_system.purpose: reality-affecting system — NOT a quest log

RECORD.long_term: Pattern ends. Deeper version locked. Echo appears later.
RECORD.visual: Shadows return to normal. Notebook entry fills in completely.

WAIT.immediate: Pattern evolves. Anomaly intensifies. Trio timer begins.
WAIT.long_term: Deeper layers unlock. Hidden content accessible. Trio Activation possible.
WAIT.visual: Shadows spread. New symbols form. Environment responds.

DEEP_RECORD.immediate: Full pattern captured. Hidden layer recorded. Maximum reward.
DEEP_RECORD.long_term: Complete understanding. No Echo. World permanently changed.
DEEP_RECORD.visual: Golden light fills the space. Symbol fully forms. Notebook glows briefly.

conditions.nela: Correct moment sensed (player must not click for 3 seconds)

visual_sequence: Environment subtly dims — not dark, but focused
Lumi notebook begins drawing on its own
Soft golden pulse radiates from anomaly location
Hidden layer appears — new symbols, new paths

echo_system.rule: The world does not reset. It echoes.
echo_system.notebook_entry: This is not the original pattern. A trace of something recorded too early.
echo_system.visual: Faded, lighter ink, slightly blurred text
